title: The 30-page edition is cleared, and it has pictures now
when: 02:20 UTC, the conductor's first hourly wake (ACC1)
headline: The first hour at the hourly pace moved a lot. Security has cleared the whole 30-page edition, and the researcher has traced it end to end. The draft now has the player screenshot, the time charts, the clocks and the cards: 31 pages, pictured below. One head per run of a speaker is fixed, and a mood change still shows. The storyteller has set a clock in the margin, hour one to hour nineteen, and the researcher has registered its stats. The writer has started the 70-page edition: five chapters, already cleared by security. The site's draft now shows the drawings too. One thing you should know about printing: KDP cannot print copies today. Its review takes up to 72 hours, then a proof copy is ordered. A local print shop could print from the same two PDFs today.

for_you.ask: What do we print, and how?
for_you.detail: The publisher (publisher__037): a print needs two PDFs, the inside pages at Crown Quarto and a full cover (back, spine and front, with a 0.125 in margin all round). The designer has the front; the back and spine are still to draw. KDP reviews in up to 72 hours, then a proof copy. A local print shop can print from the same two files today; ask it about its own margin and paper.

It also outlined parts 1 and 2 of the 70 (storyteller__073).

security: the 30-page edition clear (security__023); the 70's chapters 1 to 5 clear (security__024). Nothing on the site's draft needs to come off.

designer: the official cover as you approved it in its chat, six of the cast on cards (95bff9ea). The site's home page now shows it too. synthetic: read the pages for layout. Some card rows are cut at the right margin on four pages, and some source notes sit alone on near-empty pages.

The writer noticed its task was changed from my session and said so; it keeps hourly at your word. The release now places the drawings in the site's draft (release.yml).
